verses.gurmukhi: ਉਲਟਿ ਪਵਨ ਮਨ ਮੀਨ ਕੀ ਚਪਲ ਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aulaT pavan man meen kee chapal gat satigur parache param padh paae hai ||

en.bdb: By practicing Naam Simran (meditation on Lord's name) one can turn the wind-like wayward mind into sharp and swift movement of fish. Developing association with the word of True Guru, one attains noble state.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੂਰ ਸਰ ਸੋਖਿ ਪੋਖਿ ਸੋਮ ਸਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਦੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰ ਅਪਿਅ ਪੀਆਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: soor sar sokh pokh som sar pooran kai ba(n)dhan dhai mirat sar apia peeaae hai ||

en.bdb: Nectar of life (blissful peace) is obtained only by meditation. By burning away the indestructible ego and by killing the imperishable mind, leaving all doubts and suspicions, those who stabilise their body, their life-force finds a direction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਜਰਹਿ ਜਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਅਮਰਹਿ ਭ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਛਾਡਿ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਕੰਧ ਹੰਸ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਏ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ajareh jaar maar amareh bhraat chhaadd asathir ka(n)dh ha(n)s anat na dhaae hai ||

en.bdb: By burning away the indestructible ego and by killing the imperishable mind, leaving all doubts and suspicions, those who stabilise their body, their life-force finds a direction.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦੈ ਆਦਿ ਨਾਦੈ ਨਾਦਿ ਸਲਿਲੈ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੈ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit_en: aadhai aadh naadhai naadh salilai salil mil brahamai braham mil sahaj samaae hai ||16||

en.bdb: As the space merges with space, air with air and water mixes up with its source, so does the life-force integrates with the radiance of the Lord and supreme bliss is experienced. (16)
